title: Relations between Molecular Cloud Structure Sizes and Line Widths in the Large Magellanic Cloud
question: How do the size-line width relation of molecular cloud substructures in the LMC depend on star formation activity (8 micron intensity) and on mass surface density?

data.bands: Band 3 (CO J=1-0) for four new clouds; Band 6 (J=2-1) for 30 Dor and PCC
data.arrays: 12CO: 12m + 7m; 13CO: 12m only (Cycle 4). Archival 30 Dor and PCC include total power but not 7m
data.sensitivity: Uniform 1σ noise of 0.25 K (12CO) and 0.15 K (13CO) after adding noise; scaled by 1/√2.5 for 30 Dor

what.value: Dust temperature and column density maps of the LMC at 13 pc

evidence.quote: We use the dust temperature ($T_{\rm dust}$) and dust column density ($N_{\rm dust}$) maps generated by (cite: Utomo:19)

what.value: X_2=2.4 for CO(1-0) from virial analysis of MAGMA GMC catalog

evidence.quote: we have adopted $X_2=2.4$ for the CO(1–0) line based on the virial analysis of the MAGMA GMC catalog by (cite: Hughes:10)

what.value: MAGMA island catalog and DR3 for sample selection

evidence.quote: (cite: Wong:11) identified 450 regions of contiguous CO emission (“islands”) in the LMC via the CPROPS emission segmentation software

recipe.goal: Re-image calibrated visibilities and smooth to common resolution
recipe.method: tclean with auto-multithresh; hybrid 12m+7m multiscale for 12CO; smooth to 3.5''

recipe.goal: Build moment maps with dilated signal mask
recipe.method: Mask from 3.5σ contour expanded to 2σ, extended by 1 channel; sum in velocity

recipe.goal: LTE 13CO column density and H2 surface density
recipe.method: Tex from 12CO peak temperature, 13CO optical depth, column density formula; scaled to H2
assumptions: Beam filling fraction 1; common Tex for both lines; 12CO optically thick; N(H2)/N(13CO)=3e6

recipe.method: astrodendro on each cube; compute σ_v, σ_r, R, L, M_vir, M_CO
key_parameters: Each local max must span at least two synthesized beams in area
assumptions: d = 50 kpc; X_2=2.4 (CO 1-0), X_2=3 (CO 2-1, line ratio 0.8); M_vir = 5σ_v²R/G

recipe.method: Power law log σ_v = a1 log R + a0, per cloud and aggregate, both-axis errors
key_parameters: Points in resolution-limited gray regions excluded; 3σ confidence band plotted

recipe.goal: Compare v0 with 8 micron, 24 micron, dust and surface density
recipe.method: Colour structures by local/cloud 8um intensity; boundedness plots; cloud-averaged v0 correlations

evidence.quote: with an rms scatter of $\varepsilon = 0.25$ dex in $\sigma_v$

answer_key.quantity: Fraction of high-SNR pixels with Tex<6 K

evidence.quote: Pixels with $T_{\rm ex}<6$ K are extremely rare and account for 0.2% or less of the high SNR pixels in any given cloud.

not_stated_but_needed: Which 12CO/13CO line-free channels or continuum subtraction (if any) were used
Total-power/7m details for 13CO and exact feather parameters
How the common-beam Gaussian noise was generated (random seed)
Exact astrodendro min_value/min_delta/min_npix values and how beam-area criterion implemented
Resolution-limit exclusion regions used in fits (gray shading definition)
Uncertainty propagation for R, sigma_v in astrodendro
Calibration and flux scale uncertainty for ALMA
Observation dates and execution details for Cycle 4
missing_for_reproduction: Exact feather settings for archival data
score_reason: Public data and detailed tclean/astrodendro recipe, but robust, dendrogram thresholds, and fit exclusions are missing and imaging is heavy.
rediscovery_reason: Data are public, imaging and decomposition steps largely specified, and results are numeric power-law fit parameters.
